chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Jarir al-Qummi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Hajj is obligatory upon those who are capable (of it) every year."
ai.seo_question: Is Hajj obligatory every year for those who can afford it?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib* records the view of continuous annual obligation (Wujub al-Hajj al-Mutakarrir) for those possessing *al-jidat* (sufficient means and capacity), contrasting with the dominant Shia position that Hajj is obligatory only once. The term *al-jidat* here implies not just financial ability but also the physical and spiritual readiness to perform the pilgrimage without hardship, a nuance debated among scholars like Al-Shaykh al-Mufid and Al-Sharif al-Murtada.
